normalization_diagnosis.conclusion: Same generated norm source used different actual reduction configurations. Reusing reference norm autotuners in both variants restores exact RGB. Production norm arithmetic and selection were not modified; no cross-recompile bitwise guarantee.
normalization_diagnosis.initial_control: quality_suite uses a run routing observer equally in both variants; its timings are retained as corroboration only.
normalization_diagnosis.final_control: decode_timing and independent_width_timing bind generated norm globals once during validation. No run observer is active during warmup/timing.
normalization_diagnosis.rejected_harness: An intermediate nested observer prevented caller-global identification. The guard rejected it before timing; fixed before final_primary.

nsight_detailed.scope: CPU-only detailed attribution of two independent warmed Nsight Systems captures; no paired speedup is inferred from profile deltas.

official_latency_evidence.note: Same-process paired complete decode; norm schedules controlled and no run observer during timing. These are not Nsight latency estimates.

ffn_up_replaced_segment.interpretation: The fused GEMM+SwiGLU producer alone includes more arithmetic than old GEMM. Compare the complete GEMM/activation/quantization segment for attribution; separate captures do not establish a formal speedup.

kernel2_count_reconciliation.sequence_checks: All 49 baseline FP16 CUTLASS and all 49 candidate cuDNN kernels are followed by elementwise bias addition and the ViT input-projection Triton GEMM.
kernel2_count_reconciliation.layer_attribution: Inferred post_quant_conv 1x1x1 FP16 convolution: model klvae.py decode runs post_quant_conv before the ViT decoder; 49 occurrences match 49 decoder tile batches. No per-layer NVTX range is present, so this is sequence/source attribution rather than a named-layer annotation.
kernel2_count_reconciliation.autotune_interpretation: These are 49 warmed executions using different selected convolution kernel families, not 49 extra INT8 FFN operations. No in-capture autotune search is evidenced: one such kernel per decoder tile, with compilation and warmups outside capture.

optimization_implications: The fused producer remains the largest individual hotspot (238 registers/thread, 128 threads/CTA, 49152 bytes dynamic shared memory). Nsight Systems shows resource pressure but does not establish compute-bound versus bandwidth-bound behavior; use Nsight Compute before changing its schedule.

Flash attention, FFN-down INT8 GEMM, and QKV INT8 GEMM are the next large components. Attention-output and FFN-down share a LeanStreamK kernel name/resources and must be separated by call sequence rather than short name.
The remaining quantize_act pass processes a 7188x8192 FP16 scratch (117768192 bytes, 112.3125 MiB) per FFN call; any further fusion must preserve row absmax and FP16 rounding exactly.
Finalization and the extra 49 pre-ViT FP16 convolution calls are tiny relative to GEMMs/attention; their launch-family changes do not explain the measured FFN optimization.
Both traces report zero localMemoryPerThread/localMemoryTotal; this is not an Nsight Compute occupancy or memory-bandwidth measurement.

Independent profile processes selected different norm and other autotuned launch resources. Keep profile durations diagnostic and use the separate matched-schedule, no-observer paired benchmark for published latency.

comfy.scope: compiled Comfy wrapper smoke; random tensors, not quality

input.raw_normalized_contract: same torch.float32 Comfy IMAGE movedim(-1,1)->movedim(1,0)->unsqueeze(0), process_input (* 2 - 1), then cast FP16

notes: No encoder INT8 leaves; 72 FFN + 36 QKV + 36 output INT8 linear leaves are required.
qweight and FP32 scale device/dtype are checked before offload, on CPU, and after full CUDA reload.
Comfy wrapper encode compares against raw runtime using identical FP16-normalized RGB values.
Decoder comparison reshapes wrapper BTHWC output to raw runtime BCTHW.
Raw/wrapper compatibility is required to be finite, shape-matched, and exact; before/after metrics are reported without a zero assertion because offload algorithms may change.
Random inputs/latents prove wrapper plumbing only; they are not image/video quality evidence.
When --encoded-roundtrip is set, the report also checks decode of the actual FP16-cast wrapper.encode latent; this is a finite shape smoke, not quality evidence.

gpu_unit_tests.scope: M1/17/129, optional bias, zero/subnormal, combined registered op equivalence

cpu.scope: CPU contract and syntax checks from a clean public source snapshot; not GPU correctness/performance evidence
cpu.source_selection: git ls-files current working-tree contents plus explicit new-file allowlist

kernel_ast_check.scope: AST ignores line-number shifts; both complete decorated Triton function definitions are unchanged

cpu.host_guard_scope: Reject M > 262144 before GPU allocation/launch; actual measured M=7188 and M=14376 are unaffected

post_timing_change.description: Added host rejection for M>262144 to prevent signed INT32 address overflow, plus a CPU meta boundary test. All measured M=7188 calls are within the limit; Triton kernel function bodies are unchanged.

limitations: One SM120 shared GPU/stack; background jobs retained, our GPU experiments serialized.
Three ABBA/BAAB primary blocks and one holdout block, seed20261002; not the full six-block/three-seed ACA workflow.
Normalization schedules explicitly fixed equally in both paired variants; independent recompilation can choose different floating-point reduction orders.
Original lossy INT8 quantization remains. FP16 defaults, FP16 decode and encode performance are unchanged.
Peak allocated includes resident model/graph buffers; this is not a model-size or deployment VRAM-saving claim.
Nsight Systems only. NCU counters unavailable (ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM); no inferred bandwidth, occupancy or warp-stall diagnosis.
Competitor references are historical independent experiments; no new paired competitor speedup is claimed.
